kv22.4:1.3: atthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā dhammassavanaṃ dhammasākacchā paripucchā sīlasamādānaṃ indriyesu guttadvāratā bhojane mattaññutā pubbarattāpararattaṃ jāgariyānuyogoti.
kv22.4:1.5: natthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā …pe… pubbarattāpararattaṃ ttaṃ jāgariyānuyogoti.
kv22.4:1.7: hañci natthi gabbhaseyyāya dhammadesanā dhammassavanaṃ …pe… pubbarattāpararattaṃ ttaṃ jāgariyānuyogo no vata re vattabbe
kv22.4:2.4: parato ca ghoso yoniso ca manasikāroti.
kv22.4:2.7: parato ca ghoso yoniso ca manasikāro no vata re vattabbe
